Don't Do It at the Office

description:
The moment she witnessed her boyfriend's secret tryst, she was caught by her boss! Seoyoon accidentally witnesses her office-romance boyfriend having a secret meeting with a married section chief. She gets caught in the act by her boss, Managing Director Dohyeonjun. At Seoyoon's plea to pretend she saw nothing, Hyeonjun agrees. Seoyoon tries to quietly end things with her boyfriend, but when things don't go as planned, she contemplates resigning. Right on cue, Hyeonjun needs a translator for the overseas business headquarters and offers her a spot on the TF (Task Force) team. Hearing Hyeonjun say he will fire the two who enjoyed a tryst on the rooftop not long ago, Seoyoon joins the TF team. Afterward, Hyeonjun and Seoyoon grow rapidly closer and end up spending a night together...
